blurb: Guests can take a one-hour Founder's tour and tasting with a co-founder, including a discussion of the distilling process and a complimentary tasting. The Speakeasy Lab is an in-house cocktail bar with a curated menu of unique cocktails featuring their spirits. The distillery offers tours and tastings on most Saturdays from mid-September through early November.
extraNote: Tickets for tours are non-refundable but transferable · No online sales or shipping of alcohol due to MA state law · Ticketed events canceled by Deacon Giles will be refunded in full within 14 days · Entrance on Gardner Street, just off Canal Street, Salem, MA · Mid-September through early November for tours
